Visitor-facing positives are documented: gender-reassignment anti-discrimination protection in goods/services since 2007, hate-crime and hate-speech protection for trans identity enacted 2026, conversion-therapy offence, functioning courts and legislature. No subnational variation. Placing this in the reduced band above 0.65-C (dead-letter statute) but below 0.75 anchors where enforcement of protections is documented: roughly 0.72.
